tools_list_strict.out: {"result":{"tools":[{"name":"find_item","title":"Find item","description":"Find stock items by description or code (e.g. '5 litre silicone gasket'). Returns active items, best match first, with code, unit and whether they touch food.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string","description":"words describing the item, or its code"}},"required":["query"]},"annotations":{"title":"Find item","readOnlyHint":true,"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":false}},{"name":"check_stock","title":"Check stock","description":"Stock of an item in every warehouse: on hand, allocated, on order, reorder level and days of cover.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"item_code":{"type":"string","description":"Bahi item code, e.g. GSK-SIL-05L"}},"required":["item_code"]},"annotations":{"title":"Check stock","readOnlyHint":true,"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":false}},{"name":"find_supplier","title":"Find supplier","description":"Look a supplier up by name, tolerating different spellings. Returns the closest matches with code, city, status and whether they hold a valid food-grade certificate. Use it before registering anyone new.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","description":"the supplier's name as the user said it"},"city":{"type":"string","description":"optional city, to tell two branches apart"}},"required":["name"]},"annotations":{"title":"Find supplier","readOnlyHint":true,"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":false}},{"name":"check_budget","title":"Check budget","description":"Is a cost centre open, and how much budget is left this quarter? Without a code, lists every open cost centre.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"cost_centre":{"type":"string","description":"cost centre code, e.g. PRD-07; leave out to list the open ones"}},"required":[]},"annotations":{"title":"Check budget","readOnlyHint":true,"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":false}},{"name":"search_policy","title":"Search policy","description":"Search Rasoi's purchasing policy and the Bahi manual. Returns the relevant clauses with their citations, or says the documents do not cover it.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"question":{"type":"string","description":"the policy question in plain words"}},"required":["question"]},"annotations":{"title":"Search policy","readOnlyHint":true,"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":false}},{"name":"create_purchase_request","title":"Create purchase request","description":"Raise a purchase request (PR): the internal ask to buy something. With confirm=false it previews the estimated value and who must approve; with confirm=true it saves and submits it. Within your limit it is approved at once; above it, it waits for your manager.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"item_code":{"type":"string","description":"Bahi item code"},"quantity":{"type":"integer","description":"how many, in the item's unit"},"cost_centre":{"type":"string","description":"who pays, e.g. PRD-07"},"need_by":{"type":"string","description":"date needed, YYYY-MM-DD"},"confirm":{"type":"boolean","description":"false (default) = preview only, nothing is saved; true = commit"}},"required":["item_code","quantity","cost_centre","need_by"]},"annotations":{"title":"Create purchase request","readOnlyHint":false,"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":false}},{"name":"list_my_approvals","title":"List my approvals","description":"What is waiting for the signed-in user's signature: purchase requests and orders, with value and who raised them.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{},"required":[]},"annotations":{"title":"List my approvals","readOnlyHint":true,"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":false}},{"name":"approve_purchase_request","title":"Approve purchase request","description":"Approve or reject a purchase request that waits for the signed-in user. Only the named approver can do this, never the person who raised it.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"request_no":{"type":"string","description":"e.g. PR/2026/04417"},"decision":{"type":"string","enum":["approve","reject"],"description":"approve or reject"},"comment":{"type":"string","description":"optional note to the requester"}},"required":["request_no","decision"]},"annotations":{"title":"Approve purchase request","readOnlyHint":false,"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":false}},{"name":"create_purchase_order","title":"Create purchase order","description":"Create a purchase order (PO) with a supplier. Give request_no for an approved purchase request (it supplies item, quantity, cost centre and date), or item_code, quantity, cost_centre and need_by for a small direct order up to Rs 50,000. confirm=false previews price, tax and value; confirm=true saves it. Returns a receipt with the order's real status: an APPROVED order still has to be released.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"supplier_code":{"type":"string","description":"Bahi supplier code, from find_supplier"},"request_no":{"type":"string","description":"an APPROVED purchase request"},"item_code":{"type":"string","description":"for a direct order"},"quantity":{"type":"integer","description":"for a direct order"},"cost_centre":{"type":"string","description":"for a direct order"},"need_by":{"type":"string","description":"for a direct order, YYYY-MM-DD"},"rate":{"type":"number","description":"omit to use the contract rate"},"confirm":{"type":"boolean","description":"false (default) = preview only, nothing is saved; true = commit"}},"required":["supplier_code"]},"annotations":{"title":"Create purchase order","readOnlyHint":false,"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":false}},{"name":"approve_purchase_order","title":"Approve purchase order","description":"Approve a purchase order that waits for the signed-in user's signature.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"po_no":{"type":"string","description":"e.g. PO/2026/01182"},"comment":{"type":"string","description":"optional"}},"required":["po_no"]},"annotations":{"title":"Approve purchase order","readOnlyHint":false,"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":false}},{"name":"release_purchase_order","title":"Release purchase order","description":"Release an APPROVED purchase order to the supplier; only then does the supplier get it. Returns a receipt with the real status.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"po_no":{"type":"string","description":"e.g. PO/2026/01182"}},"required":["po_no"]},"annotations":{"title":"Release purchase order","readOnlyHint":false,"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":false}},{"name":"order_status","title":"Order status","description":"The real status of a purchase order or a purchase request, read from Bahi, with approval, goods received and any warning.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"po_no":{"type":"string","description":"e.g. PO/2026/01182"},"request_no":{"type":"string","description":"e.g. PR/2026/04417"}},"required":[]},"annotations":{"title":"Order status","readOnlyHint":true,"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":false}},{"name":"receive_goods","title":"Receive goods","description":"Record goods received (GRN) against a RELEASED purchase order: stock goes up, and the order closes once everything has arrived. Cannot receive more than was ordered.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"po_no":{"type":"string","description":"the released order the goods came against"},"quantity":{"type":"integer","description":"how many arrived"},"warehouse":{"type":"string","description":"optional; defaults to the order's warehouse"},"remarks":{"type":"string","description":"optional, e.g. vehicle number"},"confirm":{"type":"boolean","description":"false (default) = preview only, nothing is saved; true = commit"}},"required":["po_no","quantity"]},"annotations":{"title":"Receive goods","readOnlyHint":false,"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":false}},{"name":"register_supplier","title":"Register supplier","description":"Register a NEW supplier. Only after find_supplier shows no existing match. confirm=false previews and checks for duplicates; confirm=true creates it.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string","description":"registered name"},"city":{"type":"string","description":""},"state":{"type":"string","description":"Indian state"},"gstin":{"type":"string","description":"15-character GSTIN"},"confirm":{"type":"boolean","description":"false (default) = preview only, nothing is saved; true = commit"}},"required":["name","city","state","gstin"]},"annotations":{"title":"Register supplier","readOnlyHint":false,"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":false}},{"name":"send_message","title":"Send message","description":"Send a short message to a colleague or supplier (Slack handle like @rohit, or an email address). Goes through Bahi's notification queue.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"to":{"type":"string","description":"@handle or email"},"text":{"type":"string","description":"the message"}},"required":["to","text"]},"annotations":{"title":"Send message","readOnlyHint":false,"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":false}}]}}
